text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Good work!
Well, shall we start heading back—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"The next opponent I'm facing runs a lot like you.
I wanna feed that data to 'Parcae.'"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll share the analysis results with you.
Not a bad deal, right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...I see.
If it brings me closer—to fulfilling my mission.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What's going on here, what's going on?
You guys are doing something fun, aren't ya!
Let me in on it too!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Pocket, huh... Hold on a sec.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: 2400m turf. The ones who have a shot at blasting through like she did are—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Fine by me.
Just know that I expect nothing less than your best.
Don't you dare slack off.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Trainer,
I'm going for another run!
choice_data_list: Yeah, go out there and run your heart out!
Yeah, go out there and run your heart out!
No, you should get some rest today.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Trainer,
I'm going for another run!
choice_data_list: Yeah, go out there and run your heart out!
Yeah, go out there and run your heart out!
No, you should get some rest today.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
Keep your eyes wide open and watch closely.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Shakur, Kris S,
let's get a run in!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why not?
It's a chance to race against strong opponents, isn't it?
choice_data_list: You've run enough today, so don't push yourself too hard.
You've run plenty today, so don't push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I agree――pushing too hard leads to injury.
And what we're aiming for――...slips further away."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...Aaaalright, fine. We'll hold off on our all-out showdown.
Next time, let's duke it out when we're both at our absolute best!"
